## Design

### 2026-10-21: This was a really smooth session of beginning to build my MIDI Keyboard! I'd say this is all thanks to the guide, the guide is incredibly beginner friendly, or very useful to those who are familiar wi

**1.57h**

This was a really smooth session of beginning to build my MIDI Keyboard! I'd say this is all thanks to the guide, the guide is incredibly beginner friendly, or very useful to those who are familiar with KiCad. Surprisingly, it had a lot of customizable parts so my MIDI Keyboard looks a bit different than the one in the guide.

I got more work done than I usually do in one hour, but last time I overestimated myself on these projects, things went south and I ended up having to do the project in literally the last 20 minutes of the week T-T

Out of panic because I was worried I wouldn't be able to follow along, I chose the more expensive microcontroller to build my schematic around, so I'm worried for funding :/

On a brighter note, I added one less slider, so it'll hopefully be easier to build. I've never built a hardware project yet so hopefully this helps me learn through trial and error. I finished the schematics and footprint assignments, hopefully tomorrow I can wrap up the PCB? :))
